basis: Bundled SRD 5.1 only, compared against current source pages and inventory hashes.

checks: All 15 condition subsections and exhaustion table read in full; checked independent durations without severity stacking, six cumulative exhaustion levels, food/drink prerequisite and resurrection reduction.

Checked grapple escape/end conditions, invisible detection versus sight, Strength/Dexterity automatic save failures, prone 5-foot attack split, petrification resistance/immunity versus suspended disease, and critical hits only for a hit with attacker within 5 feet.
Clarified line of sight for Frightened and all carried nonmagical objects for Petrified; no new rules or 2024 exhaustion substituted.
1 action; 30 feet; V/S/M holy water; concentration up to 1 minute.
Up to three chosen creatures; optional d4 on each attack roll or saving throw before spell ends; one extra target per slot level above 1.
1 action, touch, V/S, instantaneous; 1d8 plus spellcasting ability modifier, not the raw ability score.
Undead and construct creature-type exclusions; +1d8 per slot level above 1. Corrected evocation school and ambiguous constructs/modifier wording.
1 BONUS action, 60 feet, V only, instantaneous; chosen creature must be visible.
1d4 plus spellcasting ability modifier; undead and construct exclusions; +1d4 per slot level above 1.
1 action; 120 feet; V/S; instantaneous. Three darts, each hits a chosen visible creature; no attack roll or save inserted.
Each deals 1d4 + 1 force damage; darts hit simultaneously and may share/split targets; one extra dart per slot level above 1. Explicit force damage type restored.
Reaction trigger requires being HIT by an attack or targeted by Magic Missile, not merely attacked; self, V/S, 1 round.
+5 AC includes triggering attack until START of next turn; no Magic Missile damage. No requirement to be hit by Magic Missile added.
1 action; 150 feet; V/S/M bat guano and sulfur; instantaneous.

20-foot-radius sphere, Dexterity save, 8d6 fire on failure / half on success; spreads around corners. Ignition excludes all worn/carried objects, not just hand-held objects; +1d6 per slot level above 3.
1 action; 60 feet; V/S/M straight iron; concentration up to 1 minute.
Visible humanoid only; Wisdom save or paralyzed; optional repeat save at END of each target turn, success ends only for that target.
One additional humanoid per slot level above 2; all targeted humanoids within 30 feet of each other at targeting.
Reaction only on seeing a creature within 60 feet CASTING a spell; S only, instantaneous.
Spell level <=3 fails automatically; >=4 requires spellcasting ability CHECK (not save/attack), DC 10 + interrupted spell level; success negates.
Upcast automatically negates a spell at or below the used slot level; no damage or refund invented.
1 action; 120 feet; V/S; instantaneous; choose ONE creature/object/magical effect.
Every spell <=3 on that target ends; a SEPARATE spellcasting ability check for EACH spell >=4, DC 10 + that spell level; success ends that spell.
Upcast automatic ending at/below used slot level; no claim that any non-spell magical effect is automatically dispelled.
1 action; 90 feet; V/S/M sand/rose petals/cricket alternatives; 1 minute, NO concentration added.
5d8 HP pool; creatures within 20 feet of chosen point sorted by CURRENT HP ascending, unconscious ignored; subtract full HP and require HP <= remaining pool.
Ends on duration, damage, or an action shaking/slapping awake; undead/charm-immune exclusions; +2d8 per slot level above 1. No saving throw added.
1 action; 30 feet; V/S/M licorice; concentration up to 1 minute; willing visible creature.
Double speed, +2 AC, Dexterity save advantage; extra action on EACH of its turns restricted to Attack (ONE weapon attack), Dash, Disengage, Hide, Use an Object.
After spell ends no movement/actions until AFTER next turn; no reaction ban or unrestricted extra action added.
